<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  id="Definitions_DIYSmartphoneRepair"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/diy-smartphone-repair">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_DIYRepair">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="DIY Repairer" processRef="Process_DIYRepairer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_OnlineTool" name="Online Repair Tool"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Friend" name="Friend"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Expert" name="Repair Expert"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SubmitModelDefect" name="Model and defect" sourceRef="Task_SubmitModelDefect" targetRef="Participant_OnlineTool"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ListsToCustomer" name="Materials, tools and ordering choices" sourceRef="Participant_OnlineTool" targetRef="Task_ReceiveLists"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ContactFriend" name="Borrow or buy request" sourceRef="Task_ContactFriends" targetRef="Participant_Friend"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FriendReply" name="Friend reply" sourceRef="Participant_Friend" targetRef="Task_ReceiveFriendReply"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Instructions" name="Repair instructions" sourceRef="Participant_OnlineTool" targetRef="Task_ReceiveInstructions"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ReviewVideo" name="Review and/or video" sourceRef="Task_SendReview" targetRef="Participant_OnlineTool"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PhoneToExpert" name="Phone for expert repair" sourceRef="Task_SendToExpert" targetRef="Participant_Expert"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_DIYRepairer" name="DIY Repair of a Broken Smartphone Screen" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Repair" name="Repair started">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StartToEnterModel</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterModelDefect" name="Enter phone model and broken part">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StartToEnterModel</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EnterModelToSubmit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SubmitModelDefect" name="Submit model and defect to tool">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EnterModelToSubmit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SubmitToReceiveLists</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveLists" name="Receive materials, tools and ordering choices">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SubmitToReceiveLists</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReceiveListsToSelect</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectOrdering" name="Select ordering option for each part">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReceiveListsToSelect</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SelectToCheckOwned</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckOwned" name="Check materials and tools you already have">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SelectToCheckOwned</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CheckOwnedToSourcingSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Sourcing_Split" name="Sourcing needed" default="Flow_BuyRemaining">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CheckOwnedToSourcingSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ContactFriends</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BuyRemaining</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:inclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ContactFriends" name="Contact friends about cheap items">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ContactFriends</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ContactToFriendReply</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveFriendReply" name="Receive friend reply">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ContactToFriendReply</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FriendReplyToSourcingJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_BuyRemaining" name="Buy remaining materials and tools">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BuyRemaining</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BuyToSourcingJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Sourcing_Join" name="Sourcing complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FriendReplyToSourcingJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BuyToSourcingJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SourcingJoinToReceiveInstructions</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:inclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveInstructions" name="Receive repair instructions">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SourcingJoinToReceiveInstructions</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReceiveInstructionsToRepair</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_RepairPhone" name="Repair screen following instructions">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReceiveInstructionsToRepair</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RepairToOutcome</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Repair_Outcome" name="Repair worked?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RepairToOutcome</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RepairSuccessful</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RepairFailed</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendReview" name="Send review and/or video of repair">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RepairSuccessful</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReviewToEndRepaired</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Repaired" name="Phone repaired">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReviewToEndRepaired</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendToExpert" name="Send phone to expert">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RepairFailed</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ExpertToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_SentToExpert" name="Phone handed to expert">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ExpertToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToEnterModel" sourceRef="Start_Repair" targetRef="Task_EnterModelDefect"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnterModelToSubmit" sourceRef="Task_EnterModelDefect" targetRef="Task_SubmitModelDefect"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubmitToReceiveLists" sourceRef="Task_SubmitModelDefect" targetRef="Task_ReceiveLists"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveListsToSelect" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveLists" targetRef="Task_SelectOrdering"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectToCheckOwned" sourceRef="Task_SelectOrdering" targetRef="Task_CheckOwned"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckOwnedToSourcingSplit" sourceRef="Task_CheckOwned" targetRef="Gateway_Sourcing_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ContactFriends" name="Items available cheaply from friends" sourceRef="Gateway_Sourcing_Split" targetRef="Task_ContactFriends">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>Items available cheaply from friends</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BuyRemaining" name="Remaining items" sourceRef="Gateway_Sourcing_Split" targetRef="Task_BuyRemaining"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ContactToFriendReply" sourceRef="Task_ContactFriends" targetRef="Task_ReceiveFriendReply"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FriendReplyToSourcingJoin" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveFriendReply" targetRef="Gateway_Sourcing_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BuyToSourcingJoin" sourceRef="Task_BuyRemaining" targetRef="Gateway_Sourcing_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SourcingJoinToReceiveInstructions" sourceRef="Gateway_Sourcing_Join" targetRef="Task_ReceiveInstructions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveInstructionsToRepair" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveInstructions" targetRef="Task_RepairPhone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RepairToOutcome" sourceRef="Task_RepairPhone" targetRef="Gateway_Repair_Outcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RepairSuccessful" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Repair_Outcome" targetRef="Task_SendReview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>Repair worked</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RepairFailed" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Repair_Outcome" targetRef="Task_SendToExpert">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>Repair did not work</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReviewToEndRepaired" sourceRef="Task_SendReview" targetRef="End_Repaired"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ExpertToEnd" sourceRef="Task_SendToExpert" targetRef="End_SentToExpert"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RepairSuccessful</bpmn:outgoing>

    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendToExpert" name="Send phone to expert">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RepairFailed</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ExpertToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_SentToExpert" name="Phone handed to expert">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ExpertToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToEnterModel" sourceRef="Start_Repair" targetRef="Task_EnterModelDefect"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MaterialsToReceiveTools" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveMaterialsList" targetRef="Task_ReceiveToolsList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToolsToReceiveOrdering" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveToolsList" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOrderingChoices"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderingToSelect" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOrderingChoices" targetRef="Task_SelectOrdering"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectToCheckOwned" sourceRef="Task_SelectOrdering" targetRef="Task_CheckOwned"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckOwnedToFullSet" sourceRef="Task_CheckOwned" targetRef="Gateway_Full_Set_Check"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MissingItems" name="Items still missing" sourceRef="Gateway_Full_Set_Check" targetRef="Gateway_Sourcing_Split">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>Items still missing</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AllAvailable" name="All items available" sourceRef="Gateway_Full_Set_Check" targetRef="Gateway_Items_Ready_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ContactFriends" name="Items available cheaply from friends" sourceRef="Gateway_Sourcing_Split" targetRef="Task_ContactFriends">

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BuyRemaining" name="Remaining items" sourceRef="Gateway_Sourcing_Split" targetRef="Task_BuyRemaining"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ContactToFriendReply" sourceRef="Task_ContactFriends" targetRef="Task_ReceiveFriendReply"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FriendReplyToSourcingJoin" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveFriendReply" targetRef="Gateway_Sourcing_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BuyToSourcingJoin" sourceRef="Task_BuyRemaining" targetRef="Gateway_Sourcing_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SourcingJoinToReady" sourceRef="Gateway_Sourcing_Join" targetRef="Gateway_Items_Ready_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReadyToReceiveInstructions" sourceRef="Gateway_Items_Ready_Merge" targetRef="Task_ReceiveInstructions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveInstructionsToRepair" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveInstructions" targetRef="Task_RepairPhone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RepairToOutcome" sourceRef="Task_RepairPhone" targetRef="Gateway_Repair_Outcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RepairSuccessful" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Repair_Outcome" targetRef="Task_SendReview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>Repair worked</bpmn:conditionExpression>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RepairFailed" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Repair_Outcome" targetRef="Task_SendToExpert">

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReviewToEndRepaired" sourceRef="Task_SendReview" targetRef="End_Repaired"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ExpertToEnd" sourceRef="Task_SendToExpert" targetRef="End_SentToExpert"/>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OrderingToListsJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ListsJoinToSelect</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectOrdering" name="Select ordering option for each part">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ListsJoinToSelect</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SelectToCheckOwned</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckOwned" name="Check which materials and tools you already have">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SelectToCheckOwned</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CheckOwnedToAvailableSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AllAvailable_Split" name="All required items available?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CheckOwnedToAvailableSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AllAvailableToSourcingMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MissingToFriendsSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FriendsOffer_Split" name="Friends offer items cheaply?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MissingToFriendsSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FriendsYesToContact</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FriendsNoToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ContactFriends" name="Contact friends about cheap items">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FriendsYesToContact</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ContactToFriendReply</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveFriendReply" name="Receive friend reply">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ContactToFriendReply</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FriendReplyToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Friends_Merge" name="Friend sourcing done">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FriendsNoToMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FriendReplyToMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FriendsMergeToBuy</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_BuyRemaining" name="Buy remaining materials and tools">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FriendsMergeToBuy</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BuyToSourcingMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Sourcing_Merge" name="All items ready">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AllAvailableToSourcingMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BuyToSourcingMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SourcingMergeToReceiveInstructions</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveInstructions" name="Receive repair instructions">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SourcingMergeToReceiveInstructions</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReceiveInstructionsToRepair</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_RepairPhone" name="Repair screen following instructions">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReceiveInstructionsToRepair</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RepairToOutcome</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Repair_Outcome" name="Repair worked?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RepairToOutcome</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RepairSuccessful</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RepairFailed</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendReview" name="Send review and/or video of repair">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RepairSuccessful</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReviewToEndRepaired</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Repaired" name="Phone repaired">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReviewToEndRepaired</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendToExpert" name="Send phone to expert">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RepairFailed</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ExpertToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_SentToExpert" name="Phone handed to expert">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ExpertToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToEnterModel" sourceRef="Start_Repair" targetRef="Task_EnterModelDefect"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnterModelToSubmit" sourceRef="Task_EnterModelDefect" targetRef="Task_SubmitModelDefect"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubmitToListsFork" sourceRef="Task_SubmitModelDefect" targetRef="Gateway_Lists_Fork"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ListsForkToMaterials" sourceRef="Gateway_Lists_Fork" targetRef="Task_ReceiveMaterialsList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ListsForkToTools" sourceRef="Gateway_Lists_Fork" targetRef="Task_ReceiveToolsList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ListsForkToOrdering" sourceRef="Gateway_Lists_Fork" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOrderingChoices"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MaterialsToListsJoin" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveMaterialsList" targetRef="Gateway_Lists_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToolsToListsJoin" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveToolsList" targetRef="Gateway_Lists_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderingToListsJoin" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOrderingChoices" targetRef="Gateway_Lists_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ListsJoinToSelect" sourceRef="Gateway_Lists_Join" targetRef="Task_SelectOrdering"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectToCheckOwned" sourceRef="Task_SelectOrdering" targetRef="Task_CheckOwned"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckOwnedToAvailableSplit" sourceRef="Task_CheckOwned" targetRef="Gateway_AllAvailable_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AllAvailableToSourcingMerge" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AllAvailable_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Sourcing_Merge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>All items available</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MissingToFriendsSplit" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_AllAvailable_Split" targetRef="Gateway_FriendsOffer_Split">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>Items still missing</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FriendsYesToContact" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_FriendsOffer_Split" targetRef="Task_ContactFriends">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>Items available cheaply from friends</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FriendsNoToMerge" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_FriendsOffer_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Friends_Merge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>No cheap items from friends</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ContactToFriendReply" sourceRef="Task_ContactFriends" targetRef="Task_ReceiveFriendReply"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FriendReplyToMerge" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveFriendReply" targetRef="Gateway_Friends_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FriendsMergeToBuy" sourceRef="Gateway_Friends_Merge" targetRef="Task_BuyRemaining"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BuyToSourcingMerge" sourceRef="Task_BuyRemaining" targetRef="Gateway_Sourcing_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SourcingMergeToReceiveInstructions" sourceRef="Gateway_Sourcing_Merge" targetRef="Task_ReceiveInstructions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveInstructionsToRepair" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveInstructions" targetRef="Task_RepairPhone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RepairToOutcome" sourceRef="Task_RepairPhone" targetRef="Gateway_Repair_Outcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RepairSuccessful" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Repair_Outcome" targetRef="Task_SendReview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>Repair worked</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RepairFailed" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Repair_Outcome" targetRef="Task_SendToExpert">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>Repair did not work</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReviewToEndRepaired" sourceRef="Task_SendReview" targetRef="End_Repaired"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ExpertToEnd" sourceRef="Task_SendToExpert" targetRef="End_SentToExpert"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_DIYRepairer" name="DIY Repair of a Broken Smartphone Screen" isExecutable="false">

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Friends_Merge" name="Friend sourcing done">

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ExpertToEnd" sourceRef="Task_SendToExpert" targetRef="End_SentToExpert"/>

</bpmn:definitions>
